expected_observation: If connected and beneficial, validation primary should rise mainly through improved portfolio contribution and the fixed-slice feedback should become less negative on tabs 2/4/6.

experiment_contract.claim: A deterministic per-tab affine remap in predict changes within-user ordering enough to improve weak tab slices.
experiment_contract.expected_observable: Prediction hashes differ from parent for all seeds and score distributions differ by tab.
experiment_contract.falsification_condition: No measurable improvement in trusted validation primary or prediction hashes remain identical to the parent.
forbidden_shortcuts: adding unused HP/config keys with no consumer
using any validation/test labels or post-exposure feedback as features
applying a global constant shift that cannot affect ranking
required_components: predict block applies explicit tab-indexed scale/bias arrays to scores

fallback: If this is neutral or negative, revert and prioritize a train-time context feature/operator rather than further hand calibration.
hypothesis: A small tab-specific monotone calibration will improve portfolio marginal gain by correcting weak-slice ordering errors on tabs 2/4/6 without changing train-time behavior.
implementation_plan: Edit only the predict block. Call SO.predict(model, Xs, split) to get base scores, then read the inference-time tab array via DV.load(split).tab. Apply a fixed monotone affine remap per tab id using a small hard-coded table chosen to downweight tabs with repeated negative directional feedback for the current parent branch (tabs 2,4,6) and mildly upweight tab 0. Example implementation: pred = base.copy(); pred *= scale[tab]; pred += bias[tab], with defaults 1 and 0 for unseen tab ids. Keep the mapping independent of labels and constant across seeds.
justification: Since ranking is within user and tab varies within user request contexts, a tab-conditioned remap can alter within-user order when users have candidates from different tabs. The current code exposes no tab-specific consumer except predict, so this is a connected, falsifiable slice-specialist change aimed at known weak tabs and potential portfolio diversity rather than scalar retraining.
